normalization_rules: source: append one LF when the allowlisted string has no terminal line ending
stdout: replace CRLF with LF and preserve every other byte
stderr: replace CRLF with LF and preserve every other byte
output: require valid UTF-8 after line-ending normalization
comparison: require compile status zero, runtime status zero, exact reviewed normalized compile stderr, empty runtime stderr, exact reviewed stdout, and byte-identical product/reference stdout

cases.portable_rationale: Integer comparison and explicit IF branches have no IBM storage, locale, host, or subsystem dependency.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFIF. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 VALUE-X PIC 99 VALUE 7. PROCEDURE DIVISION. IF VALUE-X > 5 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: A scalar EVALUATE with literal alternatives depends only on portable control selection.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFEVAL. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 VALUE-X PIC 9 VALUE 2. PROCEDURE DIVISION. EVALUATE VALUE-X WHEN 1 DISPLAY 'FAIL' WHEN 2 DISPLAY 'PASS' WHEN OTHER DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-EVALUATE. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: A bounded inline PERFORM and exact small-integer accumulation avoid representation and option boundaries.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFPERF. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 I PIC 9 VALUE 0. 01 TOTAL-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 4 ADD I TO TOTAL-X END-PERFORM. IF TOTAL-X = 10 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: The expression is exact at every intermediate and stays inside two display digits, so ARITH and rounding modes cannot affect it.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFCOMP. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RESULT-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. COMPUTE RESULT-X = (6 + 2) * 3 / 4. IF RESULT-X = 6 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: Small positive integer quotient and remainder are exact and do not exercise IBM intermediate precision or storage formats.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFDIV. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 QUOTIENT-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. 01 REMAINDER-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. DIVIDE 10 BY 3 GIVING QUOTIENT-X REMAINDER REMAINDER-X. IF QUOTIENT-X = 3 AND REMAINDER-X = 1 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: An alphanumeric MOVE with space padding uses portable character data and no code-page-sensitive ordering.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFMOVE. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 VALUE-X PIC X(4). PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE 'AB' TO VALUE-X. IF VALUE-X = 'AB  ' DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: ASCII-subset tallying and replacement use no collation, locale, national data, or host service.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFINSP. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 VALUE-X PIC X(6) VALUE '000ABC'. 01 COUNT-X PIC 9 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. INSPECT VALUE-X TALLYING COUNT-X FOR LEADING '0'. INSPECT VALUE-X REPLACING FIRST 'A' BY 'Z'. IF COUNT-X = 3 AND VALUE-X = '000ZBC' DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: Two fixed ASCII-subset senders exactly fill a fixed alphanumeric receiver without overflow.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFSTR. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 OUT-X PIC X(4). PROCEDURE DIVISION. STRING 'AB' DELIMITED BY SIZE 'CD' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO OUT-X END-STRING. IF OUT-X = 'ABCD' DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: Comma-delimited ASCII-subset fields fit exactly and require no locale or encoding-specific interpretation.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFUNSTR. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 SOURCE-X PIC X(5) VALUE 'A,B,C'. 01 A-X PIC X. 01 B-X PIC X. 01 C-X PIC X. PROCEDURE DIVISION. UNSTRING SOURCE-X DELIMITED BY ',' INTO A-X B-X C-X END-UNSTRING. IF A-X = 'A' AND B-X = 'B' AND C-X = 'C' DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: ABS of a small integer is exact and independent of floating, decimal-context, or storage-format choices.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFABS. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RESULT-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE FUNCTION ABS(-7) TO RESULT-X. IF RESULT-X = 7 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: MAX over small same-category integers has an exact portable result and no representation boundary.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFMAX. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RESULT-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE FUNCTION MAX(3, 7, 2) TO RESULT-X. IF RESULT-X = 7 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: MIN over small same-category integers has an exact portable result and no representation boundary.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFMIN. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RESULT-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE FUNCTION MIN(3, 7, 2) TO RESULT-X. IF RESULT-X = 2 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: MOD with small positive integers is exact and avoids negative-sign and zero-divisor dialect boundaries.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFMOD. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RESULT-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE FUNCTION MOD(10, 3) TO RESULT-X. IF RESULT-X = 1 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: REVERSE over four single-byte ASCII-subset characters has no national, DBCS, or UTF-8 width ambiguity.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFREV. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RESULT-X PIC X(4). PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE FUNCTION REVERSE('ABCD') TO RESULT-X. IF RESULT-X = 'DCBA' DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: UPPER-CASE is restricted to unaccented ASCII letters under the pinned C.UTF-8 locale.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFUP. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RESULT-X PIC X(4). PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE('aBcd') TO RESULT-X. IF RESULT-X = 'ABCD' DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.

cases.portable_rationale: LENGTH of a four-character ASCII-subset alphanumeric literal is four in both implementations without encoding-width ambiguity.
cases.source: IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. REFLEN. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 RESULT-X PIC 99 VALUE 0. PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE FUNCTION LENGTH('ABCD') TO RESULT-X. IF RESULT-X = 4 DISPLAY 'PASS' ELSE DISPLAY 'FAIL' END-IF. STOP RUN.
